title: Concept: TLS verification override configured (json) — review required
description: In json, insecure-registries disables a TLS authenticity check. Without verification, encryption still runs but against whoever answers — including an attacker. The remedy is restoring verification (TLS registries with valid certificates).
applicability: json TLS clients and configuration; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Machine-in-the-middle interception of all traffic on the connection; HIGH severity.
